items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I was trying to figure Luis, Luis, a good man, how he played.

ctx.x: Yeah. Mm-hmm. Play on that order, huh? Yeah. And who else do you remember that you could maybe give a little sample of that style? Is there anybody that you copied or anything?
I was trying to figure Luis, Luis, a good man, how he played. He played on the same style, though. Mm-hmm.
